# DealDrop

> DealDrop is a price-tracking web app that monitors public product pages and emails users when a price drops to their target.

DealDrop is free to start, requires no app install, and keeps a private watchlist with 90-day price history. Prices are extracted with Firecrawl and alert emails are delivered with Resend.

- Track products by URL and set a target price.
- Review the last 90 days of price changes per product.
- Receive email alerts when a tracked product drops.
- Sign in with Google or GitHub via Supabase auth.

## Pages

- [DealDrop home](https://deals.r6t9.space/): Product overview, tracking form, watchlist, and FAQ.
- [Terms and Privacy](https://deals.r6t9.space/terms-privacy): Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, including data use, retention, and third-party processors.
- [About](https://deals.r6t9.space/about): Why DealDrop exists, what it does, and what it does not do.
- [Methodology](https://deals.r6t9.space/methodology): How prices are collected, how often they are checked, and the limitations of the data.

- [Price tracking guides](https://deals.r6t9.space/guides): Practical guides on targets, price history, and sale cycles.
- [How to track product prices](https://deals.r6t9.space/guides/how-to-track-product-prices): Choosing the right URL, setting a useful target, and acting on alerts.
- [How to read a price history chart](https://deals.r6t9.space/guides/how-to-read-price-history): Understanding baselines, temporary spikes, and fake discounts.
- [Why prices drop](https://deals.r6t9.space/guides/why-prices-drop): Sales cycles, clearance, dynamic pricing, and a practical buying checklist.
